items.title: The Samsung Odyssey G6 G60H is the world's first 1,100Hz gaming monitor

items.lede: Samsung's newly launched Odyssey G60H display is targeted squarely at serious competitive gamers with QHD 600Hz and HD 1100HZ display modes.
items.title: Samsung just launched a gaming monitor with a refresh rate higher than its price — dual-mode Odyssey G60H offers 1,100 Hz in HD
